MusicKit / in-app player engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Music apps blur in-app playback engineering with storefront language. Xcode, Developer portal, and Connect actually separate runtime player behavior from product-page copy:

  • MusicKit, MediaPlayer, AVFoundation & catalog APIs — authorization, playback sessions, Now Playing info center wiring, and track metadata at runtime. Controls whether songs play — not App Store language. AppLocale does not implement this.
  • In-app music player UI — custom player chrome, song title rendering, queue lists, and lock-screen controls on your screens. Your listing may show Music-app mockups; implementing runtime UI is engineering, not listing copy.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Music features in the binary.

Working Music integration in the build and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Music-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Music-app-centric listings use vocabulary general audio guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe music workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

音乐 vs 音乐应用 vs Apple Music

US pages say “Apple Music” or “Music app.” China storefront copy often uses 音乐 for the music category and listener intent, 音乐应用 when naming the app category or Music home integration on gallery frames, and Apple Music when the English brand is already established on your en-US page. AppLocale aligns phrasing with each screenshot — not one blanket term for every overlay.

歌曲 vs 专辑 vs 艺术家

Now Playing screens, song rows, and Share Song cards need 歌曲 — individual tracks. Album detail pages, album artwork grids, and Library album tabs need 专辑. Artist detail pages and Library artist lists need 艺术家. Do not use 播客 or 单集 on music frames — those belong to Apple Podcasts marketing.

歌单 vs 曲库

The Playlists tab, playlist artwork, collaborative playlist badges, and Share Playlist cards need 歌单 — user-created or curated playlists. The Library tab, saved songs, albums, and artists you own or added need 曲库 — your personal music collection. Do not use English “Library” or “Playlist” left on overlays. AppLocale matches the tab or badge visible on each frame — playlist and library are different buyer surfaces in the Music app.

电台 & Apple Music Radio

Live radio stations, genre channels, and Apple Music Radio streams need 电台 or Apple Music Radio phrasing aligned to the screenshot — not generic “Stream anything” slogans. Radio frames are music discovery, not Podcast show pages.

歌词, Autoplay, Love & Suggest Less

Time-synced lyric panels on song Now Playing screens need 歌词 — scrolling lyrics that follow playback. Autoplay queue continuation needs concise captions buyers recognize. Love this song and Suggest Less feedback buttons need action vocabulary aligned to the screenshot — not English micro-copy burned into captions.

Share Song / Share Playlist cards

Share sheets and preview cards for songs or playlists need concise zh-Hans captions — 分享歌曲, 分享歌单 — rather than English “Share Song” or “Share Playlist” that breaks gallery consistency.

Spatial Audio, Crossfade, Listening History, Collaborate, Sing & Replay

When gallery frames show Spatial Audio as a Music listening badge — not an engineering diagram — captions name 空间音频 listening on supported headphones. Crossfade, Listening History, Collaborate on a Playlist, Apple Music Sing, and Replay each need frame-matched zh-Hans — distinct from Spatial Audio engineering scope on our Spatial Audio listing guide.

What good Music-app zh-Hans listing copy looks like

Strong Music listings match frame content, use commerce-idiomatic zh-Hans, and stay within Connect character limits:

  • Subtitle names the Music surface — e.g. a playlist-discovery app might use “在 Music 中创建与管理歌单” rather than a generic “Listen anywhere” slogan
  • Keywords pack Music search intent — 音乐, 音乐应用, 歌曲, 专辑, 歌单, 曲库, or 电台 as appropriate — not English “Music app” or “Play” alone
  • Description opens with the music flow buyers see — Music home, Now Playing, Library, Playlists, radio, lyrics — not abstract audio prose or Podcast episode language
  • Each caption matches its frame — Library tabs mention 曲库; playlist rows mention 歌单; Now Playing mentions 歌曲; radio frames mention 电台
  • No ranking or stream over-claims — copy describes Music integration your app supports, not chart position guarantees or invented download numbers
  • Consistent voice across fields — subtitle, keywords, description, and captions use the same Music vocabulary — not 音乐 in the title and English “Play” on every screenshot

FAQ

Does AppLocale localize in-app Music player strings or implement MusicKit?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect metadata — name, subtitle, keywords, description, and screenshot caption lines on your zh-Hans product page. MusicKit, MediaPlayer, AVFoundation, and runtime player UI are engineering tasks outside AppLocale scope.

How is Apple Music listing copy different from Apple Podcasts?

Apple Music listing copy covers gallery frames that lead with the Music app — songs, albums, playlists, radio, lyrics, and Now Playing for music tracks using 音乐, 歌曲, 专辑, 歌单, and 曲库 vocabulary. Apple Podcasts covers show pages, episode lists, subscribe/follow, and spoken-word episodes with 播客, 节目, and 单集 — a different buyer story. See our Podcasts listing guide for podcast scope; this page is Music marketing only.

Should zh-Hans copy use 歌单 or 曲库?

User-created or curated playlists — the Playlists tab, playlist artwork, and Share Playlist cards — use 歌单. The Library tab and personal music collection — saved songs, albums, and artists — use 曲库. AppLocale matches the tab or badge visible on each screenshot frame — not English “Playlist” or “Library” left on overlays.

How is this different from Spatial Audio, Background Audio, or SharePlay listing pages?

Spatial Audio engineering covers Dolby Atmos and head-tracked immersive sound as a technical story — see our Spatial Audio listing guide. Background Audio covers generic play-in-background when Music-app UI is not the lead — see our Background Audio listing guide. SharePlay covers synchronized FaceTime sessions — see our SharePlay listing guide. This page is for en-US galleries that lead with Apple Music / Music app surfaces.

Does localizing my listing change song titles or Now Playing UI inside the app?

No. Song titles, artist names, player labels, and Now Playing text come from your app binary and catalog metadata — not App Store Connect listing fields. AppLocale covers product-page marketing copy only.
